title: Aphorism § 99
text:
§ 99



On the whole, the investigation of acute diseases, or of such as have
          existed but a short time, is much the easiest for the physician, because all the phenomena
          and deviations from the health that has been put recently lost are still fresh in the
          memory of the patient and his friends, still continue to be novel and striking. The
          physician certainly requires to know everything in such cases also; but he has much less
          to inquire into; they are for the most part spontaneously detailed to him.
